detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Since 2023 I've been using Audirvana in order to have bitperfect playback of both my Qobuz and local FLAC music libraries within a single app.

A month ago I installed Music Assistant as a Docker container to test it out. I think it's the Audirvana replacement I've been looking for!

https://www.music-assistant.io/

🧵
